article.title: Was Abortion the Swing Issue for Southern Voters?
article.author: Laura O’Connor
article.content: “This is a concerted effort to keep abortion out of the headlines and out of voters' calculus," said Vasquez-Giroux. “The plan is not to be better on abortion; it’s just to put it off until [these candidates] retain power.” Read more via Scalawag : Was Abortion the Swing Issue for Southern Voters? .
